Contact Information

I encourage you to send me your comments regarding Daring Fireball. Reader-submitted reports regarding errors of any sort — factual, typographical, grammatical, political — are not merely welcome but encouraged. Unfortunately, I am at times a lousy correspondent — where by “at times” I mean “most of the time”. If I don’t respond to your email, or do so only after an inordinate amount of time has passed, please don’t take it personally.

Please address email correspondence to:

comments@daringfireball.net

For additional privacy, or simply if you prefer using it, I very much welcome you to contact me on Signal: gruber.44

For any commentary you wish to share publicly, you can mention (and follow) me on Mastodon: @gruber@mastodon.social. I really do read all my Mastodon mentions, and actively reply to them. (I mostly stay up to date on Bluesky and Threads, too.)

But if you don’t use Mastodon (or Bluesky or Threads), or have remarks you’d prefer not to share in public, feel free to use email. No need to apologize — email is always welcome.
